summary: Appends one dword value to a dynamic integer array owned by this (capacity at this+0xC, count at this+0x10, data buffer pointer at this+0x14). When count equals capacity, grows capacity by 8, allocates a new buffer of 4*new_capacity bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, copies the existing count elements, frees the old buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and repoints this+0x14. Returns the pre-increment count as the index of the appended element, then increments count.

local_names.this: dynamic integer array container (capacity this+0xC, count this+0x10, data this+0x14)
local_names.a2: value appended as the new element
local_names.result: index of the appended element (pre-increment count)

operations.description: Only grow the array when the element count at this+0x10 has reached the capacity at this+0xC
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper allocates a new buffer of 4 * new_capacity bytes
Copy the existing count of 4-byte elements from the old buffer at this+0x14 into the newly allocated buffer
Release the old buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when this+0x14 is non-null
Point this+0x14 at the newly allocated buffer
Store a2 at index count of the data buffer (this+0x14 + 4*count)
Increment the element count at this+0x10 by 1
Return the pre-increment count as the index of the appended element; called from sub_4BE010
